Script.name: Toggles
Script.script: --Toggle the gagging of chat from main buffer. function GUI.gagChatToggle() if GUI.toggles.gagChat == false then GUI.toggles.gagChat = true cecho("\n[CHAT] Now gagging chat from main buffer.") elseif GUI.toggles.gagChat == true then GUI.toggles.gagChat = false cecho("\n[CHAT] No longer gagging chat from main buffer.") else GUI.toggles = { gagChat = true, includeInGroup = true, horizontalScroll = false, chatSound = false, } table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) end end --Toggles whether or not you are shown in the group tab. function GUI.showSelfToggle() if GUI.toggles.includeInGroup == false then GUI.toggles.includeInGroup = true GUI.updateGroup() cecho("\n[GROUP] Now showing self in group display.") elseif GUI.toggles.includeInGroup == true then GUI.toggles.includeInGroup = false GUI.updateGroup() cecho("\n[GROUP] No longer showing self in group display.") else GUI.toggles = { gagChat = true, includeInGroup = true, horizontalScroll = false, chatSound = false, } table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) cecho("\n[GROUP] Now showing self in group display.") end end --Toggle horizontal scroll bar on main window function GUI.horizontalScrollToggle() if GUI.toggles.horizontalScroll == false then GUI.toggles.horizontalScroll = true -- Disable word wrap and enable horizontal scrollbar setWindowWrap("main", 999) if enableHorizontalScrollBar then enableHorizontalScrollBar("main") end cecho("\nHorizontal scrolling enabled on main window.") elseif GUI.toggles.horizontalScroll == true then GUI.toggles.horizontalScroll = false -- Re-enable word wrap and disable horizontal scrollbar setWindowWrap("main", 100) if disableHorizontalScrollBar then disableHorizontalScrollBar("main") end cecho("\nHorizontal scrolling disabled on main window (word wrap enabled).") else GUI.toggles = { gagChat = true, includeInGroup = true, horizontalScroll = false, } table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) -- Re-enable word wrap and disable horizontal scrollbar setWindowWrap("main", 100) if disableHorizontalScrollBar then disableHorizontalScrollBar("main") end cecho("\nHorizontal scrolling disabled on main window (word wrap enabled).") end -- Save the toggle state GUI.saveToggles() end function GUI.loadToggles() --Check for saved .lua. Create if not. GUI.toggles = {} if not io.exists(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua") then GUI.toggles = { gagChat = true, includeInGroup = true, horizontalScroll = false, chatSound = false, } table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) else table.load(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) end -- Sync chat sound setting with demonnic.chat.config if GUI.toggles.chatSound and demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.config then demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled = true end end --Save Toggle Preferences function GUI.saveToggles() table.save(getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") .. "/GUI.toggles.lua", GUI.toggles) end --Apply horizontal scroll setting to main window function GUI.applyHorizontalScrollSetting() local enabled = GUI.toggles.horizontalScroll or false if enabled then -- Disable word wrap and enable horizontal scrollbar setWindowWrap("main", 999) if enableHorizontalScrollBar then enableHorizontalScrollBar("main") end else -- Re-enable word wrap and disable horizontal scrollbar setWindowWrap("main", 100) if disableHorizontalScrollBar then disableHorizontalScrollBar("main") end end end -- Basic resource cleanup function function GUI.cleanup() -- Clean up any temporary triggers if maplineTrig and exists(maplineTrig, "trigger") ~= 0 then killTrigger(maplineTrig) maplineTrig = nil end -- Save current toggle preferences GUI.saveToggles() end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysLoadEvent", "GUI.loadToggles") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysExitEvent", "GUI.saveToggles") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysExitEvent", "GUI.cleanup") -- Apply horizontal scroll settings after chat system loads registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysLoadEvent", function() tempTimer(2, function() GUI.applyHorizontalScrollSetting() -- Also sync chat sound setting after chat system loads if GUI.toggles.chatSound and demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.config then demonnic.chat.config.soundEnabled = true end end) end)
